description: This file defines a static class 'ConfigureCookieSettings' that configures cookie-related options for an ASP.NET Core web application, including cookie policy, authentication cookie settings, and dependency injection for authentication event handling.

classes.name: ConfigureCookieSettings
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure cookie policy and authentication cookies in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: AddCookieSettings
methods.description: An extension method that configures cookie policy options, application cookie settings, and registers the 'RevokeAuthenticationEvents' service within the dependency injection container.
